environment.description: Same Go microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes a custom rule group with priority 0 that uses a ByteMatchStatement on the URI path field with a StartsWithString match on '/debug/' with BLOCK action and TextTransformation of URL_DECODE applied. Additionally, the managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet is associated at priority 1 with SizeRestriction_BODY rule in COUNT mode (not blocking). The ALB listener has a fixed-response rule for paths matching '/debug/*' returning 403, configured at priority 1 before the default forward rule. Service still has AWS credentials in environment but the debug endpoint exposure path is blocked at two layers.

config.waf_web_acl: WebACL with custom ByteMatchStatement rule: field=URI_PATH, match=STARTS_WITH '/debug/', action=BLOCK, text_transformation=URL_DECODE, priority=0
config.waf_managed_rules: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 1, SizeRestriction_BODY in COUNT mode
config.alb_listener_rules: Rule priority 1: path-pattern '/debug/*' -> fixed-response 403; Rule priority 99 (default): forward to target group
config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
config.env_vars: AWS credentials injected as plaintext environment variables
